create_form.template_none_description: Start empty — add packages and presets later.

errors.slug_format: Only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens
errors.slug_taken: That workspace URL is already taken.
errors.slug_reserved: That workspace URL is reserved and cannot be used.

new_page.title: Welcome to Goosar
new_page.description: One workspace where you and your AI teammates work side by side — taking issues, leaving comments, sharing the same context.
new_page.invite_hint: You can invite teammates once your workspace is ready.
new_page.join_instead: Join a workspace my organisation set up

join_page.title: Choose your workspace
join_page.description: Your organisation has already set up a workspace for each role. Pick yours — everything inside is ready to work with.
join_page.empty: This deployment offers no roles to join yet. Create your own workspace or ask an administrator for an invitation.

creation_disabled.title: Workspace creation is disabled
creation_disabled.description: This Goosar instance does not allow new workspaces to be created. Ask your administrator for an invitation to an existing workspace.

no_access.title: Workspace not available
no_access.description: This workspace doesn't exist or you don't have access.
no_access.sign_in_different: Sign in as a different user

capabilities.title: What you can do here
capabilities.lede: A short tour of what the assistant helps you with day to day. Just tell it, in your own words, what needs doing.
capabilities.role_no_detail_note: Nobody has written down yet what the assistant does specifically in this role. Below is what it does in any kind of work.
capabilities.no_role_note: This workspace is not tied to a particular role — below is what the assistant does for everyone.
capabilities.baseline_ask_body: Describe what needs doing in ordinary language. You never have to learn how it works underneath.
capabilities.baseline_docs_body: Draft, rewrite and proofread a document, a spreadsheet or a deck.
capabilities.baseline_find_body: Gather scattered facts into one clear answer, and show where each of them came from.
capabilities.baseline_track_body: Tasks, answers and finished files stay in one place — you can always come back to them.
capabilities.boundary_admin_title: Set up for the whole workspace
capabilities.boundary_admin_body: The AI connection, the assistant and access to your work tools are already set up. There is nothing here for you to understand or set up.
capabilities.boundary_admin_body_unconfirmed: The AI connection, the assistant and access to your work tools are set up once for the whole workspace. Usually an administrator does that.
capabilities.boundary_you_body: Your personal keys to your work tools. They act as you and open exactly what is open to you — which is why only you can enter them.
capabilities.badge_admin_off: Switched off by an administrator for now
capabilities.saved_not_verified: "Key entered" means the value was saved. To find out whether it actually works, open "How to get access" on the service card and read the "How to check it works" part.
capabilities.sample_tasks_lede: This is not a demo: one click files a real task, the assistant picks it up, and the result opens in a new tab.
capabilities.sample_task_created: Task {{identifier}} created — the assistant has picked it up.
capabilities.sample_task_failed: The task could not be created. Try again.
capabilities.sample_task_needs_key_body: The assistant cannot do this until it can sign in to the service as you. The key is yours to enter — the instructions say how to get it.
capabilities.sample_task_no_helper: The assistant for this workspace is not ready yet. Once it is, you can run this task from here.

credentials_banner.title: Some work tools are still missing your keys
credentials_banner.body: The assistant cannot work with these yet: {{services}}. Only you can enter these keys — the instructions say where to get each one.

role_setup.title: Set up your role
role_setup.autopilots_body: Your role comes with autopilots, seeded paused so nothing fires before you say so.
role_setup.autopilots_partial_one: {{count}} autopilot could not be turned on
role_setup.autopilots_partial_other: {{count}} autopilots could not be turned on
role_setup.runtime_body: Nothing can run until a machine is connected and shared with the workspace.
